author: TED
description: As the world races toward digital perfection, tech humanist Stephen Remedios tried to optimize the messiest and most imperfect of all human work: parenting. He shares the story of DaddyGPT, a digital version of himself built to help raise his kids — until they began to prefer it over him. What unfolds is a personal look at the limits of AI, and a reminder that what matters most isn't getting it right every time but showing up with the authentic imperfection only humans have.
title: This dad tried to get AI to help raise his kids, and it didn’t turn out the way he hoped #TEDTalks

author: TED
description:
Can we eat our way to a stronger democracy? Civic leader Anuj Gupta believes that food is one of our last common denominators. Drawing on a decade spent bringing together strangers for shared meals, he explains how the stories and memories behind our recipes can bridge divides that seem insurmountable. (Recorded at TED Democracy Philadelphia on June 13, 2026)
